headline: Arini Hedge Fund Losses Reach 32% Amid Intensifying Credit Selloff
summary: Losses at credit-focused hedge fund Arini deepened to 32% as sell-offs across corporate debt markets worsened, according to Bloomberg reports.
why: Arini is a high-profile European credit hedge fund; major performance drops indicate broader liquidity stress in speculative debt markets.

impacts.name: Arini
impacts.why: Deepening fund losses reflect severe valuation writedowns across its credit portfolio.
